concepts.gloss_en: To release/unbind the mouth of the mute — the power of speech, aspect of the kiss-union (זיווג הנשיקין); distinct from opening the barren womb

members.note: representative; tied to כח הדיבור / זיווג הנשיקין
same core dictum with 'נעשה בחינת' framing prefix; same referent (releasing the mute)

concepts.gloss_en: To open the mouth/womb of the barren — the physical union (זיווג הגופני); distinct construct head (עקרות ≠ אלמים) and different referent from releasing the mute

members.note: tied to זיווג הגופני; distinct from the mute-speech aspect

concepts.canonical_he: להתיר פה אלמים להתיר פה עקרות
concepts.gloss_en: The full paired midrashic dictum (Sanhedrin 100) encompassing BOTH releasing the mute and opening the barren; not identical to either half alone

members.form: להתיר פה אלמים להתיר פה עקרות
members.note: combined pairing of both distinct clauses; kept separate per under-merge / different-heads rules

notes: The mechanical token-overlap conflates two genuinely different concepts (mute/speech-union vs. barren/physical-union) that the text explicitly maps to different בחינות. Kept them separate. The combined phrase is treated as its own node (the whole paired dictum) rather than merged into either half.
